findings.title: "corner-widget.js has no onerror fallback" is false; wrong premise justifies the NOT NULL decision
findings.location: B.4 (corner_images.src), B.9 (NOT NULL guarantee), B.10 (Missing uploaded file)
findings.problem: The design claims three times that corner-widget.js has no onerror fallback and uses this to justify src NOT NULL and the 'shows nothing broken' note. The source sets img.onerror = function(){ this.onerror=null; this.src = App.FALLBACK_IMG; }, so the widget DOES fall back to App.FALLBACK_IMG like the other image consumers.
findings.fix: Correct all three mentions. Keep NOT NULL but restate the rationale: a NULL src would force the FALLBACK_IMG placeholder instead of the intended corner image; drop the 'no fallback' claim and the 'shows nothing broken' line (replace with 'falls back to App.FALLBACK_IMG').

findings.title: Update flow with no new image can null a NOT NULL column; invariant unspecified
findings.location: B.9 (shared image rule / NOT NULL controller invariant), B.11
findings.problem: On an UPDATE where the admin edits a non-image field and submits neither a new string nor a new file, 'resolved = uploaded path ?? submitted string' yields null and the NOT NULL column rejects the save (or required_without spuriously fails). The design does not cover 'keep existing image on update'.
findings.fix: Specify: resolved image = uploaded file path ?? submitted non-empty string ?? existing stored value. Make the string field required_without:image only on CREATE (split Store/Update FormRequests or branch on isMethod('post')); on UPDATE both image inputs are optional and absence means keep current.

findings.title: CAT_STYLE query lacks orderBy, inconsistent with B.11 'every public query orders by sort_order'
findings.problem: B.6 uses CategoryStyle::all() with no ordering while B.11 says every public query orders by sort_order and lists category among the owners. Harmless (CAT_STYLE is consumed as a keyed map, not iterated for render order) but inconsistent.
findings.fix: Either add ->orderBy('sort_order') before ->keyBy, or note in B.11 that CAT_STYLE is exempt because it is a keyed map, not an ordered list.

findings.title: car.desc read by car-detail.js is not documented as intentionally omitted from the CARS mapper
findings.problem: car-detail.js reads car.desc || CAT_DESC[car.category] || '...'. Source CARS have no desc and the mapper correctly omits it, so behavior is preserved, but the design does not call this out, risking a future contributor adding a DB desc column and changing detail-view copy.
findings.fix: Add one line to B.6 CARS: no desc key is emitted (matches source); car-detail.js derives the description from CAT_DESC[category].

findings.title: PowerShell bootstrap chained with ';' does not stop on failure
findings.problem: ';' is a statement separator in PowerShell and runs the next command even if the prior failed, so a failed key:generate still proceeds to migrate:fresh --seed and produces a confusing secondary error.
findings.fix: Run/check each command individually, or guard with '; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { break }', or use '&&' on PowerShell 7+. Document: if a step errors, stop and fix before continuing.
